test_title: PYST 51: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 8th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The amount of a sum invested for 2 years at 15%p.a is ₹9,982.50, interest compounded 8-monthly. What will be the amount (in ₹) of the same sum at the same rate and same time if the interest is compounded annually? (Nearest to ₹)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Rate =15% per annum

According to question interest is compounded 8-monthly

∴ Rate (r) = 15 × 2/3 = 10% (every 8 month)

Now by applying successive method,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7124034f09f35ad80127c45e3417d0511f4c054808028eaf9bc14a84f1b33cb1.png] 

⇒ 1331 = 9982.50 i.e. 1 = 7.5

⇒ Principal = 1000 × 7.5 = 7500

Now the interest is compounded annually

∴ Rate = 15% and Time = 2 years

By applying successive method,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a31c66a4b6fbc331d79a81fc6a6ca5ae4e6bb0baba3660cad3b941a47314aaac.png] 

⇒ 400 = 7500 i.e. 1 = 18.75

Amount = 529 × 18.75 = Rs.9918.75 

Hence, The amount will be ₹ 9919.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount = Rs.9982.50

Time = 3 years (because interest compounded 8 monthly)

Rate = 15% per annum 

**Formula used:**

A = P[1 + r/100]T

Where A = Amount, r = Rate of interest, T = Time

**Calculation:**

We have interest compounded 8 monthly, then

r = 15 × 2/3 = 10% and year will be 3 years

∴ 9982.50 = P[1 + 10/100]³

⇒ 9982.50 = P × 1.1³ = P × 1.331

⇒ P = 9982.50/1.331 = 7500

Now, if r = 15% and T = 2 years

⇒ A = 7500[1 + 15/100]² = 7500 × 1.15²

⇒ A = 7500 × 1.3225 = 1918.75

**Hence, The amount will be ₹ 9919.**
